title: Agora Reachy Voice AI Companion
tagline: Give Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini a multilingual voice with Agora Conversational AI.
description: Build a multilingual friendly AI companion for Reachy Mini with live transcripts, Murf speech, and safe voice-triggered gestures, dances, and expressions. The guide covers local USB development, Agora ARES, managed OpenAI, hosted Reachy deployment, and public-demo controls.
author: Rishi Raj Singh Ahluwalia — Director of Solutions Architecture at Agora

media.demoNote: Requires a Hugging Face account and a Pollen Robotics Reachy Mini associated with that account and online in Reachy Mini Control. The hosted community instance provides a limited daily conversation allowance.
